qualification.details: Engineer (a): The candidate should have relevant experience in design of low to medium voltage precision medical device electronics hardware. Prototyping using embedded platforms from STM32Cube, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, etc. Coordinating in-house and external PCB fabrication, with a Bachelors in electronics / mechatronics with 1 year experience. Engineer (b): Diploma in chemical Technology (Plastic & Polymer) with 5 yr exp in Injection molding.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Engineer (a): The candidate should have relevant experience in design of low to medium voltage precision medical device electronics hardware. Prototyping using embedded platforms from STM32Cube, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, etc. Coordinating in-house and external PCB fabrication, with a Bachelors in electronics / mechatronics with 1 year experience. Engineer (b): Diploma in chemical Technology (Plastic & Polymer) with 5 yr exp in Injection molding.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi), a premier government institution known for its academic excellence and research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name advertised in the IIT Delhi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is Engineer. There are two specific positions, Engineer (a) and Engineer (b), each with distinct qualification requirements.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available for the Engineer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Engineer posts, with one vacancy for Engineer (a) and one for Engineer (b).

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these IIT Delhi Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these Engineer posts at IIT Delhi is "Walk-in". Interested candidates need to attend an interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the IIT Delhi Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Engineer posts at IIT Delhi is scheduled for 27 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Engineer posts at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The salary for the Engineer posts at IIT Delhi ranges from Rs. 50000 to Rs. 90000 per month on a consolidated basis, depending on the specific role and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Engineer posts?
faq.answer: For Engineer (a), a Bachelors in electronics/mechatronics with 1 year experience is required. For Engineer (b), a Diploma in chemical Technology (Plastic & Polymer) with 5 years of experience in Injection molding is needed.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to the IIT Delhi Engineer vacancies?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Delhi Engineer vacancies. The application process is free of charge.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the IIT Delhi Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Engineer posts at IIT Delhi involves a Walk-in Test followed by an Interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview for the Engineer posts be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the IIT Delhi office in New Delhi, Delhi (Pincode: 110016). Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue details.
